sloka: स एवमुक्त्वा ज्वलनप्रकाशं रथं तुरङ्गोत्तमराजयुक्तम् ।प्रकाशमानं वपुषा ज्वलन्तं समारुरोहामरराजशत्रुः ।। ६.५९.७ ।।।।
transliteration: sa evamuktvā jvalanaprakāśaṁ rathaṁ turaṅgottamarājayuktam ।prakāśamānaṁ vapuṣā jvalantaṁ samārurohāmararājaśatruḥ ।। 6.59.7 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana, the enemy of the king of Devatas, having spoken like that ascended a chariot yoked to the best of horses, shining by virtue of its form (golden) and luminous like fire.
